title: Tailored Vaccine Messaging for Parents/Caregivers of Adolescents
official: Assessment of Adolescent and Young Adult Vaccine Confidence and Missed Opportunities for Vaccination in the Mountain West (VACCINE CONFIDENCE - WEST): A Randomized Tailored Vaccine Messaging Intervention
summary: his study will evaluate whether tailored vaccine messaging improves vaccination-related outcomes among parents and caregivers of adolescents. Participants will complete a baseline electronic survey and will then be randomly assigned to receive either a tailored vaccine message based on insurance status or a standard vaccine message delivered by SMS text message. Approximately four weeks after receiving the intervention message, participants will complete a follow-up electronic survey assessing vaccination behaviors, vaccination intentions, vaccine confidence, perceived barriers to adolescent vaccination, and perceptions of the intervention message.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 and older
* Parents/caregivers (P/C) of children/teens (C/A) aged 9 to \<18 years old, including those with public insurance/uninsured or private insurance
* Young adults (YAs) aged 18-26 residing in states west of the Mississippi River

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anyone not meeting the inclusion criteria
